title: Which Danish physicist received the 1922 Nobel Prize for proposing an atomic model featuring electrons traveling in stationary quantized orbits around a central nucleus?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Niels Bohr formulated the planetary Bohr model of the atom in 1913, explaining that electrons absorb or emit discrete radiation quanta only when transitioning between fixed, non-radiating angular momentum orbits.

title: Ernest Rutherford deduced the existence of a dense, positively charged atomic nucleus through which historic experiment in 1909?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The Alpha Particle Gold Foil Scattering Experiment
The Oil Drop Terminal Velocity Experiment
The Cathode Ray Tube Deflection Experiment

explanation: Conducted with Hans Geiger and Ernest Marsden, alpha particles were fired at thin gold foil. The rare backward deflection of particles proved that atomic mass and positive charge are concentrated in a tiny central nucleus.

title: Who is the only person to have been awarded two unshared (solo) Nobel Prizes—one in Chemistry (1954) and one in Peace (1962)?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Linus Pauling won the 1954 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for his research on the nature of chemical bonds and molecular hybridization, and the 1962 Nobel Peace Prize for his tireless crusade against above-ground nuclear weapons testing.

title: Which colorful American theoretical physicist shared the 1965 Nobel Prize for developing Quantum Electrodynamics (QED) and visual Feynman diagrams?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Richard Feynman revolutionized particle physics by introducing Feynman diagrams to visualize and calculate interactions between light and matter in Quantum Electrodynamics (QED). He also envisioned nanotechnology in 1959.

title: Emmanuelle Charpentier and Jennifer Doudna made history in 2020 as the first all-female duo to win the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Charpentier and Doudna adapted the bacterial CRISPR-Cas9 adaptive immune mechanism into programmable genetic scissors capable of editing DNA sequences in animals, plants, and microorganisms with unprecedented precision.

title: Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman received the 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for which critical biochemical discovery that enabled mRNA COVID-19 vaccines?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Nucleoside base modifications suppressing inflammatory response
Discovery of adenovirus replication capsid vectors

explanation: Karikó and Weissman discovered that replacing uridine with pseudouridine in synthetic mRNA prevents inflammatory immune responses and dramatically boosts intracellular protein translation, making safe mRNA vaccines viable.

title: Swedish geneticist Svante Pääbo won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for pioneering ancient DNA extraction and sequencing the genome of:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Svante Pääbo founded the field of paleogenomics by overcoming massive DNA degradation and contamination to sequence the complete Neanderthal genome and identify a previously unknown archaic hominin, the Denisovans.

title: Guglielmo Marconi was awarded the 1909 Nobel Prize in Physics (shared with Karl Ferdinand Braun) for his pioneering work in developing:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Marconi demonstrated practical long-distance wireless radio telegraphy, achieving the first transatlantic radio transmission from Cornwall to Newfoundland in December 1901, revolutionizing maritime and global communications.

title: British biochemist Frederick Sanger is the only person to have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry twice, for sequencing:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The amino acid sequence of insulin and DNA chain-termination sequencing
The secondary structure of collagen and synthetic insulin synthesis
The chemical structure of penicillin and vitamin B12
The active site of hemoglobin and transfer RNA folding

explanation: Sanger won the 1958 Nobel Prize for determining the complete primary amino acid sequence of the protein hormone insulin, and the 1980 Nobel Prize for developing the dideoxy chain-termination method for sequencing DNA.

title: Who is the only physicist to have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics twice (1956 for the transistor and 1972 for superconductivity)?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: John Bardeen co-invented the point-contact transistor at Bell Labs in 1947 (1956 Nobel) and later co-formulated the microscopic BCS theory of low-temperature superconductivity with Cooper and Schrieffer (1972 Nobel).

title: British crystallographer Dorothy Crowfoot Hodgkin won the 1964 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for solving the complex three-dimensional structures of which vital biomolecules?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Dorothy Hodgkin mastered X-ray crystallography to map the atomic coordinates of penicillin (1945), vitamin B12 (1955), and eventually insulin (1969), setting a gold standard for structural biochemistry.

title: Which German chemist received the 1918 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for synthesizing ammonia directly from atmospheric nitrogen and hydrogen gas?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Fritz Haber developed high-pressure, catalytic fixation of nitrogen gas (N2 + 3H2 -> 2NH3), scaled industrially by Carl Bosch. The Haber-Bosch process underpins synthetic nitrogen fertilizers feeding nearly half the global human population.

title: Arthur Ashkin won the 2018 Nobel Prize in Physics for inventing which revolutionary laser tool capable of trapping and moving microscopic living organisms?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Ashkin realized that focused laser beams exert radiation pressure and gradient forces that can trap and manipulate microscopic dielectric particles, viruses, and living bacteria without thermal damage, creating 'optical tweezers'.

title: Shinya Yamanaka and Sir John Gurdon shared the 2012 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for discovering that mature differentiated cells can be reprogrammed into:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Yamanaka discovered in 2006 that introducing four transcription factors (Oct3/4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) into mature mouse and human adult skin cells could reprogram them back into pluripotent stem cells capable of forming any tissue.

title: Thomas Alva Edison established the world's first industrial research laboratory at Menlo Park, New Jersey, and commercially perfected which device in 1879?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: While arc lamps and preliminary bulbs existed, Edison invented a practical incandescent lamp using a carbonized bamboo filament in a high vacuum that could burn for over 1,200 hours, backed by a complete electric utility distribution system.

title: Which brilliant Serbian-American inventor championed Alternating Current (AC) electrical systems and patented the rotating magnetic field induction motor?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Nikola Tesla patented polyphase alternating current power generation, transmission, and motors. His AC system triumphed over Edison's Direct Current (DC) in the 'War of Currents', powering the Niagara Falls hydroelectric project.

title: Scottish-born inventor Alexander Graham Bell was granted US Patent No. 174,465 in March 1876 for which transformative telecommunications apparatus?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Alexander Graham Bell was granted the fundamental patent for the telephone in 1876, uttering the famous first words to his assistant: 'Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you.'

title: At Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, on December 17, 1903, the Wright brothers made aviation history by achieving the world's first:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Controlled, sustained, powered heavier-than-air human flight
Hot air balloon ascent across the English Channel

explanation: Orville and Wilbur Wright flew their 12-horsepower 'Wright Flyer' biplane four times at Kill Devil Hills, with Orville making the first flight of 120 feet in 12 seconds, utilizing their patented three-axis wing-warping control system.

title: Scottish instrument maker James Watt radically improved Thomas Newcomen's primitive steam engine by introducing which crucial innovation in 1769?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: In Newcomen's engine, the cylinder was repeatedly heated and cooled with cold water spray, wasting massive energy. Watt added a separate condenser kept constantly cold while the cylinder stayed hot, multiplying fuel efficiency by 75%.

title: Johannes Gutenberg revolutionized the dissemination of knowledge across Renaissance Europe around 1440 by inventing:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Movable metal type mechanical printing press

explanation: Gutenberg combined movable metal alloy type (lead, tin, antimony), oil-based ink, and a wooden screw press in Mainz, Germany, printing his celebrated 42-line Gutenberg Bible and sparking the Printing Revolution.

title: Who is celebrated as the 'Father of the Computer' for designing the steam-powered mechanical Difference Engine and the programmable Analytical Engine?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Charles Babbage conceptualized the Analytical Engine (1837), which incorporated all basic elements of modern general-purpose digital computers: an arithmetic logic unit ('mill'), control flow via punched cards, and memory ('store').

title: Who is widely acknowledged as the world's first computer programmer for publishing the first machine algorithm intended for Babbage's Analytical Engine?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Augusta Ada King, Countess of Lovelace, translated Luigi Menabrea's paper on the Analytical Engine, appending extensive 'Notes'. Note G contained an algorithm to compute Bernoulli numbers, making her the first programmer in history.

title: While working at CERN in 1989, British software scientist Tim Berners-Lee invented which revolutionary global information architecture?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The Ethernet local area network standard

explanation: Sir Tim Berners-Lee drafted the proposal for the World Wide Web in March 1989. By late 1990, he had created HTML (Hypertext Markup Language), HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol), URLs, and the first web client and server.

title: French chemist and microbiologist Louis Pasteur developed which thermal treatment process to prevent microbial spoilage in beverages and created the first vaccine for:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Pasteur disproved spontaneous generation, established the germ theory of fermentation, invented pasteurization (heating liquids to kill pathogenic bacteria), and developed attenuated vaccines for rabies and anthrax.

title: English physician Edward Jenner is revered as the 'Father of Immunology' for developing the first successful vaccine in human history in 1796 against:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Jenner noticed that milkmaids appeared immune to deadly smallpox after contracting mild cowpox. In May 1796, he inoculated 8-year-old James Phipps with cowpox fluid, demonstrating effective cross-protective immunity.

title: Samuel Morse revolutionized long-distance telecommunications in the 1830s and 1840s by co-inventing the electric telegraph and:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Morse code (encoding text as sequences of dots and dashes)

explanation: Samuel Morse and Alfred Vail developed the single-wire electric telegraph and Morse code, transmitting the first historic telegraph message 'What hath God wrought' between Washington D.C. and Baltimore in May 1844.

title: German mechanical engineer Rudolf Diesel patented an internal combustion engine in 1892 that operates without electrical spark plugs, relying instead on:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: High compression of air to heat and ignite injected fuel
Pre-heated glow chambers ignited by external kerosene torches
Exothermic catalytic decomposition of hydrogen peroxide

explanation: The diesel engine achieves compression ignition: drawing pure air into the cylinder and compressing it to high pressure (~15:1 to 22:1), raising the air temperature above fuel autoignition before atomized diesel is injected.

title: Swedish chemist Alfred Nobel patented dynamite in 1867 by discovering that dangerous nitroglycerin could be safely handled and stabilized when mixed with:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Alfred Nobel mixed volatile liquid nitroglycerin with inert kieselguhr (diatomaceous earth), forming a pliable paste that could be shaped into cylinders and safely detonated with a blasting cap. He endowed the Nobel Prizes in his 1895 will.

title: In 1609-1610, Galileo Galilei constructed an improved refracting telescope and made which monumental observational discoveries that dismantled geocentrism?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The four large moons of Jupiter and the phases of Venus
The rings of Saturn and Uranus with its moons
The spiral arms of the Andromeda galaxy
The canals of Mars and the Kuiper belt

explanation: Galileo discovered Jupiter's four largest moons (Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto), proving bodies orbit entities other than Earth, and observed Venus exhibiting a full set of phases like the Moon, confirming Copernicus's heliocentric theory.

title: Which German mechanical engineer is credited with inventing the world's first practical commercial petrol-powered automobile (Benz Patent-Motorwagen) in 1886?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Karl Benz patented his three-wheeled 'Motorwagen' powered by a high-speed four-stroke internal combustion engine in January 1886. His wife Bertha Benz completed the famous first long-distance automobile road trip in 1888.

title: American inventor Eli Whitney transformed 19th-century agriculture and industrial manufacturing by patenting which two revolutionary innovations?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The mechanical cotton gin and standardized interchangeable parts
The mechanical grain reaper and vulcanized rubber tires
The steel-bladed moldboard plow and steam threshing machine
The seed drill and modern crop rotation nitrogen cycle

explanation: Whitney patented the cotton gin in 1794 to mechanically strip cotton fibers from seeds, multiplying cotton processing 50-fold, and later championed manufacturing muskets using interchangeable standardized components.

title: American industrialist Henry Ford revolutionized modern manufacturing in 1913 by introducing which method to assemble the Model T car?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The continuously moving conveyor-belt assembly line

explanation: Henry Ford installed a moving assembly line at Highland Park, Michigan, cutting chassis production time from 12 hours to 93 minutes. This slashed costs, making personal automobiles affordable to working-class families.

title: American prodigy Philo T. Farnsworth is recognized for inventing which foundational electronic television component in 1927?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The Image Dissector (all-electronic video camera tube)
The liquid crystal active-matrix display panel

explanation: At age 21, Philo Farnsworth transmitted the first all-electronic television image (a straight line) using his electronic image dissector tube, which converted optical images into electron streams scanned magnetically.

title: In 1839, Charles Goodyear accidentally discovered the process of vulcanization—transforming sticky raw natural latex rubber into durable, elastic rubber—by heating it with:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Goodyear discovered that heating natural polyisoprene rubber with sulfur causes disulfide cross-links between polymer chains, preventing the rubber from melting in summer heat or turning brittle in winter cold.

title: Sir Isaac Newton's monumental 1687 treatise 'Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica' laid the foundation for classical physics by formulating:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The Three Laws of Motion and Universal Gravitation
The Kinetic Theory of Gases and Entropy
The Special Theory of Relativity and Light Quanta

explanation: Newton's Principia introduced his Three Laws of Motion (inertia, F=ma, action-reaction) and the Universal Law of Gravitation (F = G*m1*m2/r^2), mathematically unifying terrestrial and celestial mechanics.

title: Archimedes of Syracuse discovered his famous Principle of Buoyancy—which states that a body immersed in a fluid experiences an upward force equal to:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The weight of the fluid displaced by the body
The total surface area of the immersed submerged object
The hydrostatic atmospheric pressure at the container bottom
The absolute density of the solid body itself

explanation: Archimedes realized this principle while stepping into a bath, famously shouting 'Eureka!'. Archimedes' Principle states that the buoyant force on a submerged object equals the weight of the displaced liquid.

title: Michael Faraday demonstrated in 1831 that an electric current can be induced across a conductor by a changing magnetic field, establishing the principle of:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Faraday discovered electromagnetic induction by moving a magnet through a wire coil, inducing an electromotive force (EMF). This single breakthrough forms the foundational operating principle of all electric dynamos, motors, and transformers.

title: Austrian monk Gregor Mendel is celebrated as the 'Father of Modern Genetics' for deducing the laws of inheritance through breeding experiments on which plant?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Between 1856 and 1863, Gregor Mendel cultivated ~29,000 pea plants, tracking seven contrasting traits to formulate the fundamental Law of Segregation and the Law of Independent Assortment.

title: Russian chemist Dmitri Mendeleev published the first widely accepted Periodic Table in 1869, arranging chemical elements primarily by atomic weight and famously:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Leaving blank gaps predicting the properties of undiscovered elements
Grouping elements purely by their electrical conductivity
Classifying elements strictly into radioactive and non-radioactive pairs
Ordering elements according to their nuclear neutron-to-proton ratio

explanation: Mendeleev organized elements with recurring valence trends and left gaps for unknown elements (e.g., eka-aluminum, eka-silicon, eka-boron), which were later discovered as gallium, germanium, and scandium with properties matching his predictions.

title: Charles Darwin's revolutionary 1859 book 'On the Origin of Species' proposed which unifying mechanism driving biological evolution?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Natural selection acting on heritable variation
Lamarckian inheritance of acquired physical characteristics
Spontaneous saltational macromutations without intermediate forms
Directed horizontal gene transfer driven by environmental desire

explanation: Darwin synthesized observations from his 5-year voyage on HMS Beagle, proposing that organisms possessing variations better adapted to their environment are more likely to survive and reproduce ('descent with modification by natural selection').

title: English polymath Robert Hooke coined the biological term 'cell' in his 1665 masterpiece 'Micrographia' after observing microscopic structures in:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Thin slices of dead cork tree bark

explanation: Hooke viewed dead plant cork tissue under his compound microscope. The porous, box-like honeycomb compartments reminded him of the small bare rooms ('cellulae') inhabited by Christian monks in a monastery.

title: Dutch draper and microscopist Antonie van Leeuwenhoek is celebrated as the 'Father of Microbiology' for being the first human to observe:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The double-helix molecular geometry of DNA

explanation: Leeuwenhoek crafted powerful single-lens glass microscopes magnifying up to 300x. In 1674-1676, he discovered protozoa, bacteria from dental plaque, red blood cells, and spermatozoa, terming them 'animalcules'.

title: French chemist Antoine Lavoisier earned the title 'Father of Modern Chemistry' by disproving the phlogiston theory and formulating which fundamental law?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Law of Conservation of Mass in chemical reactions
Law of Multiple Proportions for molecular ratios
Law of Partial Pressures for ideal gaseous mixtures
Law of Octaves for chemical periodicity

explanation: Lavoisier performed precise quantitative combustion experiments in sealed vessels, proving that matter is neither created nor destroyed during chemical transformations. He also correctly identified and named oxygen and hydrogen.

title: Nicolaus Copernicus triggered the Scientific Revolution with his 1543 book 'De revolutionibus orbium coelestium' by proposing that:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The Sun is at the center of the universe with Earth orbiting it
The Earth is static at the geometric center of celestial crystal spheres
Planets follow hyperbolic parabolic escape trajectories
Gravity travels as ripples in the cosmic ether medium

explanation: Copernicus displaced Ptolemy's 1,400-year-old geocentric orthodoxy by demonstrating mathematically that Earth and other known planets revolve around the Sun, establishing heliocentrism.

title: Johannes Kepler deduced the Three Laws of Planetary Motion using meticulous astronomical observational data recorded by which Danish astronomer?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Kepler analyzed Tycho Brahe's extensive planetary position catalogs (especially Mars), determining that planetary orbits are ellipses with the Sun at one focus, sweeping out equal areas in equal times.

title: English physician William Harvey published 'De Motu Cordis' in 1628, becoming the first scientist in human history to accurately describe:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The systemic circulation of blood pumped continuously by the heart
The chemical transmission of nerve impulses across synapses
The filtration of urea through nephron glomeruli in the kidney
The production of bile by hepatocytes in the human liver

explanation: Overturning Galenic dogma that claimed blood was constantly manufactured in the liver and consumed by tissues, Harvey proved mathematically and experimentally that blood circulates in a closed one-way loop pumped by the heart.

title: Flemish anatomist Andreas Vesalius is recognized as the 'Father of Modern Anatomy' for publishing which 1543 masterwork based on human dissection?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: De humani corporis fabrica (On the Fabric of the Human Body)

explanation: Vesalius performed his own human dissections, correcting more than 200 ancient anatomical errors that had persisted for centuries from Galen's dissections of Barbary macaques and animals.

title: Blaise Pascal formulated Pascal's Law of Fluid Mechanics, which states that external pressure applied to a confined static liquid:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Is transmitted undiminished in all directions throughout the fluid
Decreases exponentially with the depth of the fluid column
Concentrates exclusively toward the narrowest containment orifice
Increases proportional to the square of atmospheric surface area

explanation: Pascal's principle states that when pressure is exerted on an enclosed fluid, the change is transmitted undiminished to every part of the fluid and vessel walls, serving as the foundational principle of hydraulic brakes and presses.

title: Robert Boyle formulated Boyle's Law in 1662, which establishes that for a fixed mass of an ideal gas at constant temperature:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Pressure is inversely proportional to volume (P * V = constant)
Volume is directly proportional to absolute Kelvin temperature
Pressure is directly proportional to molecular molar mass
Total internal heat energy remains constant regardless of volume

explanation: Using a J-shaped mercury manometer tube, Robert Boyle proved that compressing a gas to half its volume doubles its pressure (P1*V1 = P2*V2), establishing the first empirical gas law of modern physical chemistry.

title: Scottish physicist James Clerk Maxwell unified electricity, magnetism, and light into a single comprehensive field theory in the 1860s through:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Maxwell synthesized Gauss's laws, Faraday's law, and Ampere's law (adding displacement current). His equations revealed that light is an electromagnetic wave propagating through space at speed c = 1/sqrt(mu0*epsilon0).

title: Italian physicist Alessandro Volta invented the first continuous chemical source of electric current in 1800, known as the:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Voltaic Pile (alternating zinc and copper discs in brine)
Leyden jar static charge electrostatic capacitor
Van de Graaff high-voltage electrostatic belt generator

explanation: Volta stacked alternating pairs of zinc and copper discs separated by cardboard soaked in brine electrolyte, producing the world's first electrochemical battery. The SI unit of electric potential, the volt (V), is named in his honor.

title: Hans Christian Ørsted discovered the fundamental link between electricity and magnetism in 1820 when he noticed that:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: An electric current flowing in a wire deflected a nearby magnetic compass needle
Heating a magnetic lodestone destroyed its external magnetic field
A lightning strike shattered an iron bar into polarized magnetic shards
Static electricity sparks generated visible blue ultraviolet light

explanation: During a lecture demonstration in Copenhagen, Ørsted closed an electric circuit and saw a magnetic compass needle rotate perpendicular to the conducting wire, proving that moving electric charges generate magnetic fields.

title: Austrian physicist Christian Doppler described the Doppler Effect in 1842, which explains why the observed frequency of waves changes when:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: There is relative motion between the wave source and the observer
The propagating medium undergoes a sudden adiabatic phase change
A wave traverses through an intensely magnetized crystalline lattice
The wave amplitude exceeds the structural elastic limit of the medium

explanation: The Doppler effect explains why siren pitch sounds higher as an ambulance approaches and lower as it recedes. In astrophysics, Doppler shifts (redshift and blueshift) reveal whether stars and galaxies are moving toward or away from Earth.

title: French physicist Louis de Broglie was awarded the 1929 Nobel Prize in Physics for proposing which radical wave-particle hypothesis?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: All moving matter exhibits wave-like properties (lambda = h / p)
Electrons lose mass as their kinetic energy approaches the speed of light
Light travels along geodesics bent solely by gravitational potential
Photons decay spontaneously into electron-positron pairs in vacuum

explanation: De Broglie proposed in 1924 that if electromagnetic waves display particle-like behavior (photons), then material particles like electrons must also possess wave properties with wavelength lambda = h/p, experimentally confirmed in 1927.

title: Which British mathematical genius formulated the concept of universal computing machines and helped crack Nazi Enigma ciphers at Bletchley Park?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Alan Turing laid the theoretical foundation of computer science with the Turing Machine (1936), designed the electro-mechanical 'Bombe' to break Enigma codes during WWII, and proposed the Turing Test for Artificial Intelligence in 1950.

title: The stored-program computer architecture featuring a shared memory holding both instructions and data with a CPU and arithmetic logic unit is named after:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Hungarian-American polymath John von Neumann authored the 1945 'First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC', describing the universal stored-program architecture (CPU, memory, ALU, registers, I/O) that powers modern computers.

title: US Navy Rear Admiral Grace Hopper developed the first programming language compiler (A-0) and co-designed which major business language?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Grace Hopper pioneered machine-independent programming languages and created the first linker/compiler. She also popularized the term 'computer bug' when an actual moth was extracted from a Mark II relay at Harvard in 1947.

title: American theoretical physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer served as the scientific director of the Los Alamos Laboratory during which secret WWII initiative?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Oppenheimer, often hailed as the 'Father of the Atomic Bomb', directed the Los Alamos laboratory that developed the world's first nuclear weapons, culminated in the Trinity test in the New Mexico desert on July 16, 1945.

title: Enrico Fermi achieved the world's first controlled, self-sustaining nuclear chain reaction in December 1942 inside which reactor built beneath a university stadium?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Enrico Fermi engineered Chicago Pile-1 using natural uranium fuel pellets encased in a massive lattice of graphite moderator blocks beneath the Stagg Field stands at the University of Chicago, ushering in the Atomic Age.

title: Theoretical physicist Stephen Hawking mathematically demonstrated that black holes are not completely black, but emit thermal radiation due to:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Quantum particle-antiparticle vacuum fluctuations near the event horizon
Centrifugal accretion disc plasma collisions at relativistic speeds
Thermonuclear fusion reactions within the central singularity
Decay of dark matter WIMPs within the surrounding ergosphere

explanation: In 1974, Hawking showed that quantum virtual particle pairs near a black hole's event horizon can separate—one falling into the black hole while the other escapes—causing the black hole to slowly emit 'Hawking radiation' and evaporate.

title: English biophysicist Rosalind Franklin captured which historic X-ray diffraction photograph that provided crucial evidence for the helical structure of DNA?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: At King's College London in May 1952, Rosalind Franklin and PhD student Raymond Gosling obtained 'Photo 51', an exceptionally clear X-ray diffraction pattern of hydrated B-DNA whose distinct 'X' shape proved the double-helix geometry.

title: Which charismatic astronomer hosted the acclaimed 1980 television series 'Cosmos: A Personal Voyage' and spearheaded the Voyager Golden Record message to deep space?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Dr. Carl Sagan popularized astronomy and planetary science through his book and series 'Cosmos'. He confirmed Venus's greenhouse effect, proposed liquid oceans on Europa, and chaired the committee that created the Voyager Golden Record.

title: British primatologist Dame Jane Goodall revolutionized our understanding of animal behavior through her 60-year study of wild chimpanzees at Gombe Stream, documenting that:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Chimpanzees manufacture and use tools (stripping twigs to fish for termites)
Chimpanzees possess fully articulated vocal syntactical speech
Chimpanzees migrate annually across desert biomes using celestial navigation
Chimpanzees rely exclusively on a symbiotic bacterial digestive diet

explanation: In 1960, Jane Goodall observed chimpanzee David Greybeard strip leaves off twigs to probe termite mounds, shattering the scientific orthodoxy that humans were the only tool-making animals. Louis Leakey famously remarked: 'Now we must redefine man, redefine tool, or accept chimpanzees as humans.'

title: American agricultural scientist George Washington Carver transformed Southern agriculture by promoting crop rotation with nitrogen-fixing peanuts and developing:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Over 300 commercial food, cosmetic, and industrial products from peanuts
Genetically modified hybrid high-fructose corn syrup
Mechanical hydraulic combines for harvesting wheat

explanation: At the Tuskegee Institute, Carver urged farmers to plant legumes like peanuts and sweet potatoes to restore nitrogen depleted by repetitive cotton planting, and invented hundreds of uses (dyes, plastics, cosmetics, oils) to create market demand.

title: Marine biologist Rachel Carson ignited the modern global environmental movement in 1962 with which landmark book warning against synthetic pesticides like DDT?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Rachel Carson's 'Silent Spring' meticulously documented how indiscriminately sprayed synthetic pesticides (especially DDT) bioaccumulate in food chains, thinning bird eggshells and poisoning ecosystems, leading to the establishment of the US EPA.

title: American geneticist Barbara McClintock was awarded the 1983 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for her discovery of mobile genetic elements in maize, known as:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Okazaki fragments in lagging DNA strands

explanation: Through decades of meticulous cytogenetic breeding of Indian corn (maize), McClintock proved that genetic elements (transposons) can change position within the genome, turning adjacent genes on or off, decades before molecular biology caught up.

title: American mathematician Claude Shannon is recognized as the 'Father of Information Theory' for his 1948 landmark paper that quantified data using:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Information entropy and the fundamental binary unit 'bit'

explanation: Claude Shannon's 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' introduced information entropy, proved the noisy-channel coding theorem, and established the binary digit ('bit') as the fundamental universal measure of data.

title: Which legendary computer scientist created the C programming language and co-developed the Unix operating system at Bell Labs?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Dennis Ritchie developed the C programming language between 1969 and 1973 and rewrote the Unix kernel in C with Ken Thompson, laying the foundation for modern systems programming, Linux, macOS, Android, and Windows.

title: American chemist Stephanie Kwolek invented which bullet-resistant synthetic aramid polymer fiber five times stronger than steel at DuPont in 1965?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Stephanie Kwolek formulated a liquid-crystalline poly-paraphenylene terephthalamide solution that could be spun into fibers with exceptional tensile strength and modulus, trademarked as Kevlar, utilized in body armor and aerospace composites.

title: Chinese pharmaceutical chemist Tu Youyou received the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for discovering artemisinin, a breakthrough therapy against:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Tu Youyou combed through ancient Chinese medical texts, discovering that low-temperature ether extraction of sweet wormwood (Artemisia annua) yielded artemisinin, which became the world's most potent antimalarial agent, saving millions of lives.

title: Rainer Weiss, Barry Barish, and Kip Thorne were awarded the 2017 Nobel Prize in Physics for decisive contributions to the LIGO detector and the first observation of:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Gravitational waves emitted by colliding binary black holes
The Higgs boson scalar excitation field at CERN
High-energy cosmic neutrino bursts from blazar TXS 0506

explanation: On September 14, 2015, the twin LIGO laser interferometers detected gravitational waves (GW150914) from the merger of two black holes 1.3 billion light-years away, confirming Albert Einstein's 100-year-old General Relativity prediction.

title: British mathematical physicist Sir Roger Penrose was awarded the 2020 Nobel Prize in Physics for mathematically proving that:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Black hole formation is a robust prediction of the General Theory of Relativity
The universe's expansion is accelerating driven by dark energy
Neutrinos oscillate between flavors and possess non-zero mass
Superstring compactification occurs exclusively in 11 dimensions

explanation: In 1965, Roger Penrose developed the mathematical concept of 'trapped surfaces' to prove that gravitational collapse inevitably leads to a physical spacetime singularity, demonstrating black holes are natural features of Einstein's relativity.

title: Chinese-American experimental physicist Chien-Shiung Wu, known as the 'First Lady of Physics', famously conducted the 1956 Wu Experiment that proved:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The violation of parity conservation in weak nuclear beta decay
The existence of neutral strange kaon meson oscillations
The quantization of electric charge on falling oil droplets
The non-existence of magnetic monopoles in cosmic radiation

explanation: Using supercooled Cobalt-60 atoms at the National Bureau of Standards, Dr. C. S. Wu demonstrated that beta particles were emitted preferentially in the direction opposite to the nuclear spin, proving nature distinguishes left from right in weak interactions.

title: Which Austrian-Swedish nuclear physicist provided the theoretical explanation of nuclear fission alongside Otto Frisch, but was unjustly overlooked by the Nobel Committee?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Lise Meitner and Otto Frisch interpreted Otto Hahn's bombarding of uranium with neutrons, realizing the uranium nucleus had split into barium and krypton, coining the term 'fission'. Element 109, Meitnerium (Mt), is named in her honor.

title: During the historic 18th G20 Heads of State and Government Summit held in New Delhi in September 2023, which permanent regional bloc was officially admitted as a new member of the G20 under India's Presidency?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)

explanation: At the 18th G20 Leaders' Summit in Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, India championed the historic admission of the 55-nation African Union as a permanent member of the G20, giving a powerful voice to the Global South.

title: Following the historic soft landing of Chandrayaan-3 near the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023, what official name was designated for the touchdown site of the Vikram lander?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that the Chandrayaan-3 landing site would be named 'Shiv Shakti Point', while the Chandrayaan-2 crash site was named 'Tiranga Point', and August 23 was designated as 'National Space Day'.

title: India's first dedicated solar space observatory, Aditya-L1, was successfully inserted in January 2024 into a halo orbit around which point in space?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Aditya-L1 was placed in a halo orbit around the Sun-Earth L1 point, approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth, enabling continuous observation of the Sun without any occultation or eclipses.

title: In the newly inaugurated Parliament House of India, which historical sacred golden sceptre from the Chola tradition was installed near the Speaker's chair in the Lok Sabha?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The historic Sengol, crafted in Tamil Nadu and presented to Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru on the eve of Independence in 1947 to symbolize the transfer of power, was installed in the new Lok Sabha chamber by PM Narendra Modi.

title: The Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023, also celebrated as the 'Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam', provides for what percentage of reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam mandates a 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha, the Delhi Legislative Assembly, and all State Legislative Assemblies for a 15-year period post-delimitation.

title: Inaugurated in January 2024, the 'Atal Bihari Vajpayee Sewri-Nhava Sheva Atal Setu' holds which national infrastructure distinction?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Longest sea bridge in India (21.8 km)
Longest underwater railway tunnel in India
Highest cable-stayed bridge in the world

explanation: The Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (MTHL), officially named Atal Setu, spans 21.8 km (16.5 km over sea), connecting Sewri in South Mumbai to Chirle near Nhava Sheva in Navi Mumbai.

title: The world's highest railway arch bridge, towering 359 meters above the river bed, was constructed as part of the USBRL rail project in Jammu & Kashmir over which river?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The Chenab Rail Bridge stands 359 meters (1,178 ft) above the Chenab riverbed—35 meters taller than the Eiffel Tower—connecting Bakkal and Kauri in Reasi district of Jammu and Kashmir.

title: Which national initiative launched by the Government of India in 2024 aims to provide free electricity up to 300 units per month to 1 crore households through rooftop solar installations?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: With a total investment of over ₹75,000 crore, PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana provides substantial central subsidies to install rooftop solar panels in 10 million households across India.

title: Project Cheetah, the world's first intercontinental translocation of large wild carnivores, reintroduced wild cheetahs from Namibia and South Africa to which National Park in Madhya Pradesh?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Cheetahs, which had been declared extinct in India in 1952, were reintroduced in September 2022 and February 2023 at Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh to restore grassland and savanna biomes.

title: Under India's Deep Ocean Mission, what is the name of the indigenous manned submersible designed to carry three scientists to an ocean depth of 6,000 meters?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Developed by the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), Chennai, 'Matsya 6000' is a titanium-alloy sphere submersible designed for deep-sea exploration of polymetallic nodules and marine biodiversity at 6 km depth.

title: India's real-time payment system UPI (Unified Payments Interface) has expanded globally, enabling cross-border peer-to-peer linkages with which first foreign national payment system in 2023?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: In February 2023, India's UPI and Singapore's PayNow launched a historic cross-border linkage allowing instant, low-cost bilateral fund transfers. UPI has since expanded acceptance to France, UAE, Sri Lanka, Mauritius, and Nepal.

title: In alignment with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, what is the name of the permanent 12-digit digital education identity card launched for all students in India?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: APAAR ID ('One Nation, One Student ID')

explanation: APAAR (Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry) is a unique 12-digit student ID linked to DigiLocker and the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) to track academic credentials and accomplishments seamlessly.

title: The grand ceremonial avenue stretching from Rashtrapati Bhavan to India Gate in New Delhi was revamped under the Central Vista project and renamed as:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Formerly known as Rajpath (and Kingsway during British colonial rule), the 3-km ceremonial boulevard was rechristened 'Kartavya Path' (Path of Duty) by PM Modi in September 2022 to shed colonial-era mindsets.

title: The 108-foot-tall bronze 'Statue of Oneness' depicting the 8th-century philosopher Adi Shankaracharya as a young boy was unveiled in 2023 at which holy town?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Erected atop the Mandhata mountain in Omkareshwar along the Narmada River, the 108-ft 'Statue of Oneness' (Ekatmata Ki Pratima) commemorates Adi Shankaracharya where he met his guru Govinda Bhagavatpada.

title: Who served as the Chairman of the High-Level Committee (HLC) on 'One Nation, One Election' which submitted its comprehensive report in March 2024?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Ram Nath Kovind (Former President of India)

explanation: Former President of India Ram Nath Kovind chaired the 8-member High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections, recommending synchronized elections for Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies followed by local body elections.

title: The 206-foot-tall 'Statue of Social Justice', the world's tallest statue of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar outside of his memorials in Maharashtra, was unveiled in January 2024 in which Indian city?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The 'Statue of Social Justice', standing 206 feet tall (including an 81-foot pedestal), was inaugurated at Swaraj Maidan in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, as a tribute to Babasaheb Ambedkar's constitutional legacy.

title: India's premier semi-high-speed indigenous passenger train, manufactured by the Integral Coach Factory (ICF) in Chennai, is known as:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Vande Bharat Express (originally Train 18) is an indigenous electric multiple unit (EMU) train manufactured by ICF Chennai featuring aerodynamic nose cones, regenerative braking, and operational speeds up to 160 km/h.

title: At the 2023 UN Climate Change Conference (COP28), Prime Minister Narendra Modi proposed which major global environmental campaign focused on creating a localized 'Green Credit' marketplace?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Co-hosted by India and UAE at COP28 Dubai, the Green Credit Initiative aims to incentivize voluntary pro-planet environmental actions like afforestation and water conservation beyond conventional carbon offset markets.

title: In January 2024, the BRICS alliance formally admitted several new full member states. Which of the following nations was among the newly inducted members?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: At the 15th BRICS summit in Johannesburg, invitations were issued leading to the accession of UAE, Iran, Egypt, and Ethiopia into BRICS on January 1, 2024.

title: Which Nordic nation became the 31st member of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) in April 2023, followed by Sweden as the 32nd member in March 2024?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Following decades of military non-alignment, Finland officially joined NATO on April 4, 2023, doubling the military alliance's direct border with Russia, with Sweden joining as the 32nd ally in March 2024.

title: The historic UN Climate Change Conference COP28 held in Dubai, UAE in December 2023 produced the 'UAE Consensus', which for the first time explicitly called on nations to:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems
Immediately ban all commercial international air travel
Cease all domestic agricultural livestock farming by 2030
Decommission all nuclear fission power plants globally

explanation: COP28 approved the landmark UAE Consensus calling for 'transitioning away from fossil fuels in energy systems, in a just, orderly and equitable manner... so as to achieve net zero by 2050', alongside establishing the Loss and Damage fund.

title: Which historic transnational transport and infrastructure corridor was unveiled on the sidelines of the G20 New Delhi Summit to link India, the Arabian Gulf, and Europe?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The IMEC MOU was signed by India, the US, Saudi Arabia, UAE, France, Germany, Italy, and the EU to connect rail networks and ship-to-rail transit, electricity cables, and clean hydrogen pipelines from India to Europe.

title: The United Nations General Assembly officially declared the year 2023 as the International Year of what, following an initiative sponsored by India?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Championed by India and supported by 72 nations, the UN declared 2023 as the International Year of Millets (IYM 2023) to highlight the nutritional, climate-resilient, and food-security benefits of sorghum, pearl millet, ragi, and other 'Shree Anna'.

title: Which country has continuously retained the #1 rank as the world's happiest country in the UN World Happiness Report for seven consecutive years through 2024?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Finland has ranked as the happiest country on Earth for seven straight years according to the World Happiness Report, credited to high social trust, universal healthcare, strong education, and proximity to nature.

title: The Global Biofuels Alliance (GBA) was launched at the 2023 G20 Summit by India alongside which two leading biofuel-producing nations?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: India, the United States, and Brazil (who together produce 85% of global ethanol) co-founded the Global Biofuels Alliance (GBA) to accelerate the global uptake of sustainable biofuels like ethanol and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF).

title: Where is the global headquarters of the International Solar Alliance (ISA), an international treaty-based intergovernmental organization initiated jointly by India and France?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The International Solar Alliance (ISA) is headquartered at the National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) campus in Gurugram, India, making it the first treaty-based intergovernmental organization to be headquartered in India.

title: In March 2024, the European Parliament enacted the world's first comprehensive legal framework regulating Artificial Intelligence, known as:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act)

explanation: The EU AI Act classifies artificial intelligence applications into risk-based tiers (unacceptable risk, high risk, specific transparency risk, minimal risk) and bans harmful practices like cognitive behavioral manipulation and untargeted facial recognition scraping.

title: Which South American nation formally inaugurated Javier Milei as its President in December 2023, introducing sweeping radical economic deregulation policies?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Libertarian economist Javier Milei took office as President of Argentina in December 2023, initiating sweeping deregulation, closing government ministries, and devaluing the Argentine peso to tackle hyperinflation.

title: In 2023 and 2024, maritime traffic through the vital Bab-el-Mandeb strait and the Red Sea was disrupted due to attacks on international merchant vessels by which group based in Yemen?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Houthi missile and drone strikes forced major global shipping lines to divert cargo ships away from the Suez Canal around the Cape of Good Hope at the southern tip of Africa, increasing global transit times and costs.

title: The principal judicial organ of the United Nations, the International Court of Justice (ICJ), is located in which European city?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The ICJ, seated at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands, settles legal disputes between member states and provides advisory opinions on international legal questions.

title: Which nation hosted the 29th UN Climate Change Conference (COP29) in November 2024 in its capital city of Baku?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Azerbaijan hosted COP29 in Baku along the Caspian Sea, focusing heavily on agreeing on the New Collective Quantified Goal (NCQG) for international climate finance for developing nations.

title: The regional grouping BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation) has its permanent Secretariat located in:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: BIMSTEC includes 7 member nations (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Thailand). Its permanent secretariat was established in Dhaka, Bangladesh in 2014.

title: Which prominent East Asian nation celebrated the crowning of its 102nd Prime Minister, Shigeru Ishiba, in October 2024?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Shigeru Ishiba, former Defense Minister, was elected leader of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and took office as Japan's Prime Minister, succeeding Fumio Kishida.

title: A severe drought exacerbated by the 2023-2024 El Niño phenomenon caused unprecedented transit restrictions and freshwater supply shortages in which vital maritime canal?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Unlike the sea-level Suez Canal, the Panama Canal relies on freshwater from Gatun Lake to operate its lock chambers. Severe drought compelled the Panama Canal Authority to slash daily vessel transits by over 30%.

title: On January 1, 2024, ISRO successfully launched XPoSat (X-ray Polarimeter Satellite), making India only the second nation after the USA to deploy a dedicated satellite for studying:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Cosmic X-ray polarization from black holes and neutron stars
Gravitational wave vibrations in deep space
Low-frequency radio emissions from the lunar far side

explanation: XPoSat carries two scientific payloads—POLIX and XSPECT—to study the polarization of intense X-rays from astronomical sources like pulsar wind nebulae, black hole binaries, and active galactic nuclei.

title: What is the name of the female humanoid robot astronaut developed by ISRO to fly aboard the uncrewed test missions of India's human spaceflight project, Gaganyaan?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Vyommitra ('friend in the sky') is an AI-powered half-humanoid robot designed to monitor environmental parameters in the crew module, operate control panels, and simulate human physiological functions.

title: In February 2024, the robotic lander 'Odysseus' (Nova-C), developed by Intuitive Machines, achieved which landmark achievement in space exploration?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: First commercial, privately built spacecraft to soft-land on the Moon
First robotic probe to return samples from the core of an asteroid
First nuclear-powered rover to drill on Mars
First spacecraft to complete a close flyby of Neptune's moon Triton

explanation: Houston-based Intuitive Machines landed Odysseus near the lunar south pole under NASA's CLPS program, marking the first commercial lunar soft landing and the first American lunar landing since Apollo 17 in 1972.

title: In January 2024, Elon Musk's neurotechnology startup Neuralink achieved which medical-technological milestone?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Successfully implanted a wireless brain-computer interface (BCI) chip in a human patient
Synthesized the first artificial human heart ventricle from titanium
Reversed neurological damage using stem-cell nanobots in primates
Created an optical cortical bionic eye restoring complete color vision

explanation: Neuralink implanted its 'Telepathy' wireless brain chip (64 threads with 1,024 electrodes) in paralyzed patient Noland Arbaugh, allowing him to control a computer mouse cursor and play chess solely using his thoughts.

title: In May 2024, severe geomagnetic solar storms triggered by massive coronal mass ejections from giant sunspot cluster AR3664 produced which rare global atmospheric spectacle?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Vibrant auroras visible at unusually low latitudes, including Ladakh in India
Complete global blackout of deep oceanic hydrothermal vents
A sudden 5-minute reversal of Earth's rotational axis
Persistent green noctilucent clouds over the equatorial belt

explanation: The G5-class geomagnetic solar storm—the strongest since Halloween 2003—lit up night skies with pink and green auroras as far south as Mexico, the Mediterranean, and Hanle in Ladakh, India.

title: In May 2024, Indian aerospace startup Agnikul Cosmos achieved a historic milestone by launching the world's first rocket powered by a single-piece 3D-printed engine, named:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Chennai-based Agnikul Cosmos launched Agnibaan SOrTeD from India's first private launchpad at Sriharikota, powered by 'Agnilet'—the world's first single-piece 3D-printed semi-cryogenic rocket engine.

title: Which breakthrough gene-editing therapy, known commercially as Casgevy, made medical history in late 2023 by becoming the world's first approved CRISPR-based medicine for:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Sickle cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia
Cystic fibrosis and pulmonary arterial hypertension

explanation: Developed by Vertex Pharmaceuticals and CRISPR Therapeutics, Casgevy uses CRISPR-Cas9 to edit patients' hematopoietic stem cells to reactivate fetal hemoglobin production, effectively curing sickle cell and beta-thalassemia.

title: In 2023-2024, the World Health Organization (WHO) recommended which second cost-effective, high-efficacy malaria vaccine, developed by the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The R21/Matrix-M vaccine, developed by the Jenner Institute at Oxford and manufactured at scale by Serum Institute of India (SII) in Pune, demonstrated over 75% efficacy and is being rolled out across Africa.

title: India's fastest AI supercomputing system, ranked prominently on the global TOP500 list and installed at C-DAC in Pune, is called:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: AIRAWAT (AI Research Analytics and Knowledge Dissemination Platform)

explanation: AIRAWAT, installed under the National Program on AI at C-DAC Pune, delivers 13,170 teraflops of compute capacity and was ranked among the top 100 supercomputers in the world.

title: The joint Earth-observing satellite mission NISAR, featuring advanced dual-frequency synthetic aperture radar to map global environmental changes every 12 days, is a partnership between ISRO and:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) is a landmark joint radar observatory equipped with L-band radar (NASA) and S-band radar (ISRO) to measure changes in ice sheets, ecosystems, and tectonic faults.

title: To commemorate 50 years of Project Tiger in 2023, Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched which global coalition in Mysuru to protect the world's seven major big cat species?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Headquartered in India, the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) unites 97 range nations to conserve the Tiger, Lion, Leopard, Snow Leopard, Cheetah, Jaguar, and Puma.

title: What vital chemical element was unambiguously confirmed on the lunar south pole surface in August 2023 by the LIBS instrument aboard the Chandrayaan-3 Pragyan rover?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy (LIBS) instrument aboard the Pragyan rover unambiguously confirmed the presence of Sulfur (S) on the lunar surface, along with Aluminum, Calcium, Iron, and Titanium.

title: In February 2024, ISRO successfully launched its advanced meteorological satellite INSAT-3DS aboard GSLV-F14 to enhance:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Weather forecasting, disaster warning, and oceanic monitoring

explanation: INSAT-3DS is a dedicated third-generation meteorological satellite designed to monitor Earth's surface, generate accurate weather forecasts, and track cyclones and ocean temperatures.

title: Which revolutionary space telescope discovered evidence of carbon-bearing molecules like methane and carbon dioxide in the atmosphere of habitable-zone exoplanet K2-18b in 2023?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: NASA/ESA/CSA's James Webb Space Telescope used transmission spectroscopy to detect carbon-bearing molecules in the atmosphere of K2-18b, a Hycean exoplanet 120 light-years away in the constellation Leo.

title: India approved the landmark National Quantum Mission (NQM) in 2023 with a budget exceeding ₹6,000 crore to develop quantum computers with a target capacity of:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The National Quantum Mission positions India alongside the US, China, and Austria in developing quantum hardware (50-1000 qubits), quantum key distribution (QKD) satellite links, and quantum magnetometers.

title: Scientists at the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory's National Ignition Facility (NIF) in California achieved scientific 'fusion ignition' multiple times, producing:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: More net energy from nuclear fusion than the laser energy directed at the fuel target
A stable room-temperature magnetic levitation field lasting 48 hours
The cold annihilation of positrons in atmospheric nitrogen gas
An artificial micro-black hole sustained in vacuum suspension

explanation: Using 192 ultra-powerful ultraviolet lasers focused on a deuterium-tritium fuel pellet, NIF achieved controlled thermonuclear fusion net energy gain (ignition), proving the physical feasibility of clean fusion power.

title: In 2023, Google DeepMind unveiled AlphaMissense, an artificial intelligence model that made a monumental breakthrough by predicting:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Whether single-letter genetic mutations (missense variants) are disease-causing or benign
The precise timing of earthquakes from plate boundary acoustic waves
Optimal trajectories for orbital interplanetary gravitational slingshots
The melting point of all synthetic inorganic polymer resins

explanation: AlphaMissense classified 71 million possible human missense mutations (single-letter DNA changes altering an amino acid), predicting that 32% are likely pathogenic and 57% benign, drastically accelerating genetic disease diagnosis.

title: The Indian Men's Cricket Team won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup in June 2024 at Bridgetown, Barbados, by defeating which country in a thrilling final?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Led by Rohit Sharma, India defeated South Africa by 7 runs at Kensington Oval to lift their second ICC Men's T20 World Cup title (after 2007), following which both Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli announced their retirement from T20 internationals.

title: At the 19th Asian Games held in Hangzhou, China in 2023, India achieved a historic milestone by crossing the 100-medal mark for the first time with a total tally of:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: India achieved its best-ever Asian Games performance under the campaign 'Iss Baar 100 Paar', winning 107 medals and finishing 4th on the overall medal leaderboard.

title: Who became the youngest player in chess history at age 17 to win the FIDE Candidates Tournament in Toronto in April 2024, earning the right to challenge for the World Chess Championship?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Grandmaster D. Gukesh from Chennai scored 9/14 in Toronto to win the FIDE Candidates at age 17, breaking Garry Kasparov's 40-year-old record to become the youngest challenger in World Chess Championship history.

title: At the 45th FIDE Chess Olympiad held in Budapest, Hungary in September 2024, India created sporting history by:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Winning historic Gold medals in both the Open and Women's team sections
Winning Silver in the Open section and Bronze in the Blitz section
Sweeping all four individual board prizes while finishing 3rd overall
Qualifying for the final without playing a single tiebreak game

explanation: India accomplished a historic double Olympiad triumph, winning team Gold in the Open section (Gukesh, Praggnanandhaa, Erigaisi, Vidit, Harikrishna) and Women's section (Harika, Vaishali, Divya, Vantika, Tania).

title: At the Paris 2024 Olympic Games, who became the first athlete from independent India to win two Olympic medals at a single edition of the Games?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Manu Bhaker won bronze in the Women's 10m Air Pistol and another bronze in the Mixed Team 10m Air Pistol alongside Sarabjot Singh at the Paris 2024 Olympics.

title: At the Paris 2024 Olympic Games, reigning champion Neeraj Chopra claimed which medal in the Men's Javelin Throw with an 89.45-meter throw?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Neeraj Chopra secured the Silver medal with an 89.45m throw, becoming the first track-and-field athlete from independent India to win consecutive individual Olympic medals (Gold in Tokyo 2020, Silver in Paris 2024).

title: At the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games, India delivered its finest performance in history by winning how many total medals?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: India achieved a record 29 medals (finishing 18th in the world) at Paris 2024, with stars like Avani Lekhara (Gold in shooting), Sumit Antil (Gold in javelin), and Sheetal Devi (Bronze in armless archery).

title: At age 43, Indian tennis legend Rohan Bopanna made history in January 2024 by winning the Australian Open Men's Doubles title (with Matthew Ebden) and becoming:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The oldest World No. 1 and oldest Grand Slam champion in the Open Era
The first player to win Grand Slams across four different decades
The player with the most consecutive service aces in a Grand Slam final
The fastest server in Australian Open tournament history

explanation: Rohan Bopanna became the oldest first-time World No. 1 in men's doubles at 43 years and 330 days, as well as the oldest Grand Slam men's doubles champion in the Open Era.

title: Which Spanish tennis sensation defeated Novak Djokovic in back-to-back Wimbledon Men's Singles finals in 2023 and 2024?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Carlos Alcaraz captured consecutive Wimbledon Gentlemen's Singles crowns in 2023 (in an epic 5-set final) and 2024 (in straight sets), adding to his US Open 2022 and French Open 2024 titles.

title: Which national team won the UEFA Euro 2024 championship in Berlin, Germany, by defeating England 2-1 in the final?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Spain won all seven matches at Euro 2024 to lift their record fourth European Championship, with 17-year-old winger Lamine Yamal named Young Player of the Tournament.

title: Which South American nation clinched the Copa América 2024 championship in Miami, USA, defeating Colombia 1-0 in extra time to win their record 16th title?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Led by Lionel Messi and coached by Lionel Scaloni, Argentina defended their Copa América title with a 112th-minute goal from Lautaro Martínez, completing a triple major trophy sweep (Copa 2021, World Cup 2022, Copa 2024).

title: Who won the Women's Premier League (WPL) 2024 cricket title, defeating Delhi Capitals in the final in New Delhi under the captaincy of Smriti Mandhana?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Royal Challengers Bangalore defeated Delhi Capitals by 8 wickets at the Arun Jaitley Stadium to win the second edition of the WPL, led by captain Smriti Mandhana with star performances by Ellyse Perry and Shreyanka Patil.

title: Indian dynamic badminton duo Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty achieved which historic milestone in 2023-2024?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Became World No. 1 and won India's first-ever Asian Games badminton Gold
Won four consecutive Olympic Gold medals in men's doubles
Completed a calendar year undefeated across 50 international matches
Won the singles, doubles, and mixed titles at the World Championships

explanation: 'Sat-Chi' won India's first-ever Asian Games badminton gold medal at Hangzhou 2023, won the Asian Championships, and became the first Indian doubles pair to attain the BWF World No. 1 ranking.

title: Spain won the FIFA Women's World Cup 2023 held in Australia and New Zealand by defeating which nation 1-0 in the final in Sydney?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Spain captain Olga Carmona scored the decisive goal against England's Lionesses at Stadium Australia, making Spain only the second country (after Germany) to win both men's and women's FIFA World Cups.

title: Who was awarded the 'Player of the Tournament' at the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2023 in India after scoring an unprecedented 765 runs?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Virat Kohli scored 765 runs in 11 matches (averaging 95.62 with three centuries), breaking Sachin Tendulkar's 2003 record for the most runs in a single World Cup and registering his 50th ODI century.

title: The Indian Men's Hockey Team secured consecutive Olympic medals by winning which medal at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games under captain Harmanpreet Singh?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: India defeated Spain 2-1 in the bronze medal playoff at Paris 2024, winning back-to-back Olympic hockey medals (Tokyo 2020 bronze, Paris 2024 bronze) in legendary goalkeeper PR Sreejesh's farewell match.

title: Which sport made its official Olympic debut as a medal event at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games at the Place de la Concorde?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Breaking made its Olympic debut at Paris 2024, with B-Boy Phil Wizard (Canada) and B-Girl Ami (Japan) winning the inaugural gold medals in battle format. Cricket and Squash will return at Los Angeles 2028.

title: In 2024, the Government of India conferred the Bharat Ratna—India's highest civilian honor—on five distinguished personalities. Which pioneer of the Green Revolution in India was among them?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The 2024 Bharat Ratna was awarded to Karpoori Thakur, L. K. Advani, P. V. Narasimha Rao, Chaudhary Charan Singh, and agricultural scientist Dr. M. S. Swaminathan for transforming India's food security.

title: Iranian human rights activist Narges Mohammadi was awarded the 2023 Nobel Peace Prize for her brave struggle against the oppression of women in Iran under the motto:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 2023 Peace Prize to imprisoned activist Narges Mohammadi for championing women's rights and human rights, highlighted by the 'Woman, Life, Freedom' movement.

title: South Korean novelist Han Kang was awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature 'for her intense poetic prose that confronts historical traumas and exposes the fragility of human life', famous for writing:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Han Kang became the first South Korean writer and the first Asian woman to win the Nobel Prize in Literature. Her landmark novel 'The Vegetarian' won the International Booker Prize in 2016.

title: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton for foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Artificial neural networks using statistical physics
Superconducting topological qubits in dilution fridges

explanation: John Hopfield created an associative neural network that can store and reconstruct patterns using physics principles, while Geoffrey Hinton invented the Boltzmann machine, laying the groundwork for modern Deep Learning.

title: Demis Hassabis, John Jumper, and David Baker were awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for computational protein design and revolutionary AI protein structure prediction through:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: AlphaFold (predicting 3D structures of virtually all known proteins)

explanation: DeepMind's Demis Hassabis and John Jumper developed AlphaFold2 to solve the 50-year-old protein folding grand challenge, predicting the 3D structures of 200 million proteins, while David Baker pioneered de novo protein design.

title: At the 95th Academy Awards (Oscars) in 2023, India celebrated a double triumph with 'Naatu Naatu' winning Best Original Song and which film winning Best Documentary Short Subject?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Directed by Kartiki Gonsalves and produced by Guneet Monga, 'The Elephant Whisperers' won the Oscar for Best Documentary Short, depicting indigenous couple Bomman and Bellie caring for orphaned elephant Raghu.

title: The prestigious 58th Jnanpith Award, India's highest literary honour, was conferred jointly in 2024 on renowned Urdu poet/lyricist Gulzar and which distinguished Sanskrit scholar?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: The 58th Jnanpith Award recognized celebrated polymath, poet, and lyricist Sampooran Singh Kalra (Gulzar) for Urdu literature and spiritual leader and polyglot author Jagadguru Rambhadracharya for Sanskrit literature.

title: Which veteran actor and producer was conferred the Dadasaheb Phalke Lifetime Achievement Award for 2022 at the 70th National Film Awards in 2024?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Mithun Chakraborty, who debuted with Mrigayaa (1976) winning a National Film Award, was honored with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award—Indian cinema's highest honor—for his monumental five-decade career.

title: Irish author Paul Lynch won the prestigious 2023 Booker Prize for Fiction for which dystopian novel set in a totalitarian Dublin?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Paul Lynch's 'Prophet Song' depicts a mother of four, Eilish Stack, fighting to keep her family together as Ireland descends into tyranny, praised for its suffocating urgency and literary power.

title: Indian surgical oncologist Dr. Ravi Kannan R. was awarded the 2023 Ramon Magsaysay Award ('Asia's Nobel Prize') for his selfless service in providing pro-poor cancer treatment in which region?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Cachar Cancer Hospital and Research Centre in Assam

explanation: Dr. Ravi Kannan left a prominent practice in Chennai to transform the rural Cachar Cancer Hospital and Research Centre in Silchar, Assam, offering free or low-cost compassionate cancer care to underprivileged tea-garden workers.

title: India's highest sporting honor, the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award for 2023, was jointly awarded to which world-champion athletic pair?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Neeraj Chopra and Kishore Jena (Javelin Throw)

explanation: The Khel Ratna was conferred on badminton champions Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty for their Asian Games Gold, Asian Championship title, and achieving the World No. 1 ranking.

title: Which century-old publishing institution in Uttar Pradesh was awarded the prestigious Gandhi Peace Prize for 2021 in recognition of its outstanding contribution to social and cultural transformation?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Established in 1923 by Jaya Dayal Goyandka and Ghanshyam Das Jalan, Gita Press Gorakhpur has published over 41 crore books (including 16 crore copies of the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita) without commercial advertising.

title: At the 66th Annual Grammy Awards in February 2024, Indian fusion supergroup 'Shakti' won the Grammy for Best Global Music Album for:
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Shakti—comprising tabla maestro Ustad Zakir Hussain, singer Shankar Mahadevan, guitarist John McLaughlin, percussionist V. Selvaganesh, and violinist Ganesh Rajagopalan—won the Grammy for their studio album 'This Moment'.

title: French-American mathematician Michel Talagrand was awarded the prestigious 2024 Abel Prize (often dubbed the 'Nobel of Mathematics') for groundbreaking work in:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Probability theory, stochastic processes, and spin glasses
The Langlands Program and automorphic forms
Algebraic topology and topological quantum field theory
Optimal transport theory and Ricci curvature bounds

explanation: The Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters awarded the Abel Prize to Michel Talagrand for his groundbreaking contributions to probability theory, concentration of measure phenomena, and mathematical understanding of spin glasses.

title: Japanese architect Riken Yamamoto was awarded the 2024 Pritzker Architecture Prize (the highest global architecture honor) for designs emphasizing:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Community, interconnected public spaces, and social transparency

explanation: Riken Yamamoto was recognized for blurring the boundary between public and private domains, creating buildings that foster communal connection and mutual aid across housing projects, schools, and civic institutions.

title: Indian environmental activist Alok Shukla was awarded the prestigious 2024 Goldman Environmental Prize ('Green Nobel') for leading a successful grassroots campaign to protect:
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: Hasdeo Aranya forests in Chhattisgarh from coal mining expansion
Aravalli biodiversity ridge in Haryana from illegal quarrying
Silent Valley rainforest in Kerala from hydroelectric dams
Sundarbans mangrove delta from industrial shrimp farms

explanation: Alok Shukla mobilized the Hasdeo Aranya Bachao Sangharsh Samiti, leading indigenous Adivasi communities to safeguard 445,000 acres of biodiverse pristine forests (the 'Lungs of Chhattisgarh') from 21 proposed coal mines.

title: India observes August 23 every year as 'National Space Day' to commemorate which historic milestone in space exploration?
subject: General Awareness & Logic

options.text: The successful soft landing of Chandrayaan-3 on the Moon (2023)
The orbital insertion of Mangalyaan into Martian orbit (2014)
The launch of India's first satellite Aryabhata (1975)
Rakesh Sharma's historic spaceflight aboard Soyuz T-11 (1984)

explanation: August 23 was officially designated as National Space Day by Prime Minister Narendra Modi to celebrate India becoming the first nation to soft-land near the Moon's south pole and the fourth nation to land on the Moon.

title: Celebrated annually on June 21, the International Day of Yoga was established by the UN General Assembly in 2014 following a proposal championed by which country?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: UNGA adopted Resolution 69/131 in December 2014 with a record 175 co-sponsoring nations. June 21 was selected as it is the summer solstice, the longest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere.

title: World Environment Day is celebrated globally every year on June 5. What was the central global theme for World Environment Day 2024 hosted by Saudi Arabia?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
explanation: Under the slogan 'Our land. Our future. We are #GenerationRestoration', World Environment Day 2024 focused on combating desertification, restoring degraded lands, and building drought resilience.

title: National Youth Day is observed in India on January 12 every year to mark the birth anniversary of which great spiritual leader and philosopher?
subject: General Awareness & Logic
